dedupe_keys.name: meteor tanzania flood hazard map pluvial for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: This METEOR release supplies Tanzania-wide pluvial flood-depth grids made by SSBN Ltd (Fathom). Ten public GeoTIFF files are listed under ODbL 1.0, one each for 5, 10, 20, 50, 75, 100, 200, 250, 500 and 1000-year return periods. Zenodo states depths in metres, WGS84 coordinates and 3-arcsecond, roughly 90 m resolution. The provider describes a two-dimensional shallow-water simulation driven by MERIT elevation and hydrography, designed for regional guidance. A modeller can overlay these layers with roads, energy assets or clinics for pluvial-flood exposure scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers Tanzania pluvial METEOR maps. A limitation is that the layers show local event maxima, not one spatially coherent flood occurring at once. The method relies on regional or global inputs and is not recommended for detailed site engineering. The page does not supply local calibration evidence for each cell. No raster contents or depth values were checked.
